options_blocking_help.message: Cuskwam sherias kuzuia durkatikag blacklist kikaos. The whitelist is what stays reachable durkatikag whitelist kikaos. Bundled categauies kuzuia commkwenye wakati skatikaks.

options_bundled_categories_help.message: Bundled lists wa commkwenye wakati skatikaks. Toggle a whole akatikaa, then fungua it kwa keep skatikagle kwavutis available.

options_schedule_help.message: Kikaos start on their own inside these windows. Strictness set here applies for the whole window.

options_rules_help.message: facebook.com covers that domakatika na every subdomakatika. news.ycombkatikaatau.com covers that subdomakatika na anythkatikag under it. /youtube\.com\/shauts/ matches the full URL as a regular expressikwenye.

options_number_error_whole.message: $LABEL$ must be a whole number wa zero au greater.

LABEL.example: Minutes of site access per 30 minutes of focus

options_number_error_minute_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within the supported dakika range.

options_number_error_day_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within the supported siku range.

options_session_defaults_help.message: Njia na strictness are fixed wakati a kikao kuanzas. These are the thamanis the kuanza kwam funguas na.

options_strictness_flexible_label.message: Bkatikagu: end the kikao wakatiever you choose

options_strictness_friction_label.message: Nguvu: kusimamapkatikag early uses the ckwenyefigured kufikiri gate

options_strictness_hard_label.message: Ngumu: no early end, tempauary kwavuti kufikia kwenyely

options_cycle_help.message: Defaults: 25 dakika focus, 5 dakika break, 15 dakika long break every 4th cycle. Breaks on a schedule beat break-when-you-feel-like-it for mood and focus in study samples. The exact dakikas are convention, not science.

options_cycle_default_label.message: Mzunguko mtazamo na mapumzikos by default

options_gate_help.message: A 10 seckwenyed wait na an explicit nyuma-kwa-kazi kitufe measurably reduces impulse visits (field study, PNAS 2023). The lkwenyeger wait na the akatikaad sentence roughly double the effect.

options_custom_delay_error.message: Cuskwam delay must be a positive whole number wa seckwenyeds.

options_gate_force_end_label.message: Wezesha "Ignore timeout and end anyway" button

options_credit_help.message: Tovuti kufikia crhariri accrues while you mtazamo. Both kufikia kwa all kwavutis na a skatikagle-kwavuti unlock spend from the same balance. You can step away at any wakati naout spendkatikag crhariri.

options_earn_rate_label.message: Minutes of site access per 30 dakikas of focus

options_streak_help.message: The streak counts sikus that reach the goal. One default session keeps the chain alive, and a freeze token repairs a missed siku.

options_category_uncheck_help.message: Uncheck a kwavuti kwa keep it available while the rest wa the akatikaa is kuzuiaed.

options_sound_preview_error.message: Could not pretazama the sound. Try agakatika.

options_session_complete_notification.message: Onyesha a system notification when a session completes

options_badge_countdown.message: Onyesha the remaining time on the toolbar icon

options_privacy_website_off_detail.message: Fokasi Lock cannot block websites until you grant access.

options_privacy_website_unregistered_tit.message: Tovuti access is granted, but blocking is not active

options_privacy_website_unregistered_det.message: Chrome granted access, but Fokasi Lock could not register its blocking script.

options_privacy_website_on_detail.message: Fokasi Lock can apply your active blocking rules on regular website pages.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Maliziaing the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.

This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device, plus local-only aggregate statistics. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Maliziaing the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.

options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_bo.message: This permanently kufutas remote mipangilio, kuzuia na allow lists, kwavuti kufikia crhariri, msururus, na domakatika-level kuzuiaed-attempt aggregates from Chrome Sync. Local mipangilio na statistics stay kwenye this device.

options_privacy_confirm_all_action.message: Thibitisha delete all Fokasi Lock data

options_privacy_all_body_intro.message: This permanently deletes every piece of Fokasi Lock data on this device and any Fokasi Lock copies left in Chrome Sync:

options_privacy_all_body_outro.message: Deleting everything is available only while no session is running. Fokasi Lock then returns to setup.
